name: HowLongToBeat API (via HLTB unofficial)
tagline: Game completion-time estimates via community wrappers for HowLongToBeat
description: Community libraries and reverse-engineered endpoints that expose HowLongToBeat completion-time data (main story, extras, completionist) for backlog tools, game databases, and recommendation apps. There is no official public API; most clients scrape or call undocumented site endpoints.

auth.details: No official API key; community libraries scrape howlongtobeat.com or call undocumented site endpoints without public auth.

example.response_snippet: {"data":[{"game_id":10270,"game_name":"The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild","comp_main":50000,"comp_plus":100000,"comp_100":150000}]}

use_cases: look up main-story completion time for a game title
compare how long games take for backlog planning
enrich a game library with HLTB time estimates
search HowLongToBeat for a title and get match candidates
